verdict.rationale: BILL's own docs show it can set up users, budgets, and virtual cards for spend management, and it markets controlled 'smart, flexible cards'. That is the virtual-card half of the story with budget-based controls. Physical card issuance, an explicit per-card spend limit, and issuance speed are not documented. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance, documented per-card spend limits (as opposed to budgets), evidence of issuing cards in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit

citations.quote: Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards.
